note: Run #159 (checkmyapp.dev, 2026-09-08) as recorded in production D1. Steps are verbatim apart from observed text truncated to 120 characters; actions are the machine trail (CHE-129) exactly as stored.

finding.title: Credential/notes field in 'Add login & notes' didn't accept input

detail.where: /check — 'Add login & notes' accordion, test-login/notes text field
whatWeTried: Attempted to type test credentials into the notes field
detail.whatHappened: The field is present in the DOM but the input attempt did not take — we could not enter text here, whereas the sign-in email field on /sign-in accepted input normally in the same run.
detail.whyItMatters: This field is how Starter/Growth customers give you test logins so checks can run behind their auth — the paid feature depends on it. Confirm the field accepts and persists input so credential-backed checks aren't silently blocked.
